segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The dealer lays his card face down and rises halfway from his chair, returning the bow with a slow, exaggerated flourish. The fresco-side player hunches over his stack of coins.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Finest company, she says, and she says it so sweetly. You flatter old creatures of the dark, my lady, and flattery is a coin we count carefully down here. But the dead keep this road, and the dead are owed their due. Ten gold a head for safe passage through our hall. Will you pay what the road asks, sweet-tongue?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: Will you pay what the road asks
